Cookies & browser storage

Ink Wire Education is operated by Ink Wire LLC. We do not use advertising cookies, analytics cookies, or tracking pixels.

Signing in securely

When you sign in, we use essential cookies to recognise your signed-in session and keep your account secure. They are not used for advertising or to track you across websites.

With Remember me unchecked, the sign-in cookie is a browser-session cookie. Some browsers can restore these cookies when they restore your tabs, so always sign out on a shared device.

If you choose Remember me, the sign-in cookie can remain for up to seven days and may be renewed while you use your account. Signing out ends that session.

Dashboard and notebook storage

The dashboard previews use browser storage to save work you enter, such as notebook drafts, quiz answers and lesson assessments. This is separate from cookies and is not used for tracking.

Time zone, navigation and read-status choices stay within the current page session. Saved demo work remains in that browser until you clear the site’s stored data. Export any notebook work you want to keep before clearing it.

The shared demo notebook connects to Liveblocks when you open it and sends that notebook’s content and collaboration presence to the service. It is a public development demo: use fictional information only.

Your controls

You can block cookies or clear this site’s cookies and storage in your browser settings. Blocking the sign-in cookies prevents account access. Clearing browser storage removes locally saved demo work.

We do not show an optional-cookie banner because we do not use advertising, analytics or optional preference storage. If we introduce a new optional use, we will explain it and request consent before enabling it.
